points.description: States that the assumption does not hold (arrivals are not independent) for real internet traffic, and explains why: traffic is bursty, so the probability of an arrival depends on/is influenced by previous arrivals. Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark: says No and gives the burstiness / dependence on previous arrivals reason. No mark for answering Yes, or for saying No with no reason or an unrelated reason.
